griidc-adt-speed-core-kinetic-indigo.citation: DUACS (2025), Gridded absolute dynamic topography – Gulf subset – daily time series 1993–2019, GRIIDC.
griidc-adt-speed-core-kinetic-indigo.access: Immutable original NetCDF SHA-verified and processed only in the cloud on one low-priority CPU, one dated slice at a time. Original Hamilton et al. (2003) and Rowe and Kennicutt (2009) source pages and all three diagnostic images actually reviewed. Nineteen geometry/speed-core tests passed. Kinetic July and Indigo May pass; Kinetic September rejected and supplies no measurement. Core and numerical range only, with explicit proxy/composite/registry qualifications.

records.case_label: Kinetic dated source-case speed core; physical identity unverified
records.source_locator: Original DUACS daily ADT 2000-07-02; Hamilton et al. (2003), MMS 2003-049, Figures 1-1 / 2-3d and printed page 14; Eddy K / Kinetic over mooring site.
records.definition: Spherical area inside the maximum circum-averaged geostrophic-speed contour.
records.scope: OSW-derived speed-core diagnostic for this dated named source case. Physical registry crosswalk unverified; no neighboring/secondary values inherited.
records.qualification: Maximum perimeter-averaged geostrophic speed selects a core contour. Fixed 0.005/0.0025 m level steps pass convergence gates; their range plus outward rounding is numerical only, not physical uncertainty or an annual range. Mapping, MDT and gradient/interpolation errors remain unquantified; sampling/support and search radius are not effective resolution or positional accuracy. Core radius is not outer radius; bounding arcs are not principal width; mean geostrophic speed is not a local current maximum or direct ADCP observation. Kinetic point is a manually read mooring map proxy, not an author-reported center; the nominal July 2 source map represents an approximately seven-day composite, distinct from the daily DUACS coordinate. September 24 fails and supplies no measurement. No physical footprint, state containment, ranking, playback or exact lifetime inferred.
